## Description

**What**: Update fork-URL references in source: CLAUDE.md:56, plugins/dso/README.md:9, tests/scripts/test-create-dso-app-real-url.sh:11,33,34, docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md:270 (annotated [deprecated; archived YYYY-MM-DD]), docs/onboarding.md:16, docs/designs/create-dso-app-template-contract.md (rewritten), docs/designs/dso-nextjs-starter-plugin-install.md:3, .github/workflows/template-real-url-e2e.yml:4. Run `gh repo archive navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template --yes` (NOT `gh repo edit --archived=true`); idempotent. Sequence: real-URL E2E test (S9 + impl) merged + green BEFORE fork archive commit; fork archive is the FINAL PR of the epic. Stderr redirected to log to avoid triggering surrounding error-handling.
**Why**: Fork archival closes the migration; deferring until E2E is green prevents stranding users; mechanical grep verification is the only signal that nothing references the fork after the epic completes.
**Scope**:
- IN: Source ref updates (file:line list above) with KNOWN-ISSUES.md entries annotated; gh repo archive --yes with idempotent re-run handling; mechanical `git grep -l 'digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template' HEAD -- ':!docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md'` returns zero matches.
- OUT: Migration tooling for fork users (release-notes only); upstream contribution branches.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, every listed file:line is updated and KNOWN-ISSUES entries annotated [deprecated; archived YYYY-MM-DD] ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, post-archive: `gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template --jq .archived` returns true ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, `git grep -l 'digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template' HEAD -- ':!docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md'` returns zero matches ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, the fork archive commit is the FINAL PR of the epic AND the new E2E test is green on the prior PR ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for any helper used in the archival flow

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Sequencing constraint enforced — fork archive last
- [Reliability] gh repo archive idempotent per gh source; --yes avoids prompt

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, fork URL refs are updated and the legacy fork is archived as the final PR
